text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Such a nice tune... Thank you for the<n>present,
Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Music is like a wind that stirs my<n>heart. It feels
good in a way that's<n>different from running.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome... But you really like<n>it? All I did
was play the piano as my<n>present.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm not good enough to call that a<n>gift... Maybe I
should go out and get<n>you a real present.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No, your rhythmic tones are always<n>like an easterly
wind that gently<n>brushes through budding flowers...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've had your wind blow<n>over me, I feel
like I can bloom into<n>my full glory.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Easterly wind... Um, the wind in<n>spring? That must
be a compliment.<n>Thank you.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Speaking in terms like that, I like your<n>tones as well,
Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The way you play the trumpet so<n>clearly is
refreshing. How do I say it...<n>Yes, it's like a breeze
in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A morning breeze... Really? I'm so<n>happy to be
spoken of that way.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Miracle, in that case, would you let<n>me celebrate
your birthday with my<n>morning breeze?
